title: PETRONAS Sovereign Resource Stewardship Schema
not_sealed_notice: Schema design for a future WEALTH/GEOX mode. Pending WEALTH organ maintainer review and implementation. Do NOT promote to L1 without source bundle for PETRONAS inputs.
description: Models whether extra PETRONAS dividends are safe fiscal support or resource cannibalization. Implements the auditor's insight: 'PETRONAS is not a fiscal plug; it is a national resource battery.'

conversion_assumptions.note: Use explicit gas-to-boe conversion assumptions in every model run. Placeholder only until a PETRONAS datapack carries field-specific factors.

production_decline_rate_pct.description: Annual production decline without new reserves (%).

monthly_operating_cost_rm_b.description: Average monthly operating cost (MYR billion). Used for 6mo liquidity floor.

requested_extra_dividend_rm_b.description: Additional dividend requested by federal above base (MYR billion). Negative = reduced.

lng_brent_linked_pct.description: % of LNG revenue Brent-linked. Below 40 = decoupling risk.

capex_deferral_risk.description: true if requested extra dividend cuts upstream_capex below prior 3y mean

national_resource_damage_flag.description: true if reserve_replacement_ratio < 0.8 OR reserve_life_years < 8 OR capex_deferral_risk

safe_extra_dividend_rm_b.description: Computed safe extra dividend. ZERO if any floor fails. No exceptions.

lng_decoupling_detected.description: true if lng_brent_linked_pct < 40 while Brent > 80 (false comfort trigger)

fiscal_gap_rm_b.description: Federal deficit gap after PETRONAS base + safe_extra_dividend

rules: national_resource_damage_flag = true if RRR < 0.8 OR reserve_life < 8 OR capex_deferral_risk
stress_state = RED if any floor fails OR lng_decoupling_detected = true
stress_state = BLACK if national_resource_damage_flag = true AND requested_extra_dividend > 0
stress_state = AMBER if all floors pass but resource_cannibalisation_risk in MEDIUM
stress_state = GREEN if all floors pass and risk LOW

verdict_logic.green: all floors pass and resource_cannibalisation_risk = LOW
verdict_logic.amber: all floors pass and resource_cannibalisation_risk = MEDIUM
verdict_logic.red: any floor fails or lng_decoupling_detected = true

forbidden_promotion: Do not promote to L1 (canonical SEAL) without source bundle for PETRONAS inputs (production, capex, reserves, dividends, net cash, taxes) covering at least 2021-2025.
test_fixtures_required: baseline scenario (Brent=75, FX=4.40, all floors pass)
